'''Woodcraft Wanderer''' is an [[Advanced enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A small battle puppet created by a Snowpriestess. It is in charge of keeping the Snowy Forest safe. Do not underestimate its fists of wood, for they can smash through stone with hardly any effort.}}

==Overview==
* '''INNATE:''' '''Woodcraft Wanderers''' have 2 [[Shield Stack]]s.
* When the '''Woodcraft Wanderer''' has no shield stacks, it will attempt to {{Color|trap|7}} at the currently-controlled operator's position, temporarily preventing movement.
** If the currently-controlled operator is successfully {{Color|trapped|7}}, it will then charge for a short time to deal damage to the operator and recover 2 Shield Stacks. During the charge, casting any skill interrupts the charge. Interrupting the charge prevents the enemy from recovering Shield Stacks and {{G|Dispel|dispels}} the currently-controlled operator's trapped state.
